notes: Read https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro for the benchmark figures on models/deepseek-v4-pro. Excluded: 'Terminal Bench 2.0' (v2.0, not the allowed 2.1); base-model rows such as MMLU 90.1 and HumanEval 76.8 (DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base checkpoint, not the released post-trained model).
